about_the_game:
Centuries-old stone walls tower over the coast — the remains of a grand castle built on greed. Long ago, workers digging deep beneath its foundations struck gold. But with the treasure came something else… something that should have remained buried. Those who discovered it never returned, and the castle was abandoned, left to crumble under whispers of a deadly curse.

You and your team of treasure hunters have come for two reasons: to uncover the truth of what happened, and to claim the gold for yourselves. But soon, it becomes clear that the castle is not as empty as it seems. A dark presence moves in the shadows, watching, waiting, and hunting.

In this 4-player online co-op horror experience, you’ll explore the decaying halls, sealed tunnels, and hidden rooms of the castle. Work together to solve intricate puzzles that open new paths, reveal pieces of the castle’s grim history, and bring you closer to the treasure. Every decision matters — not just for progress, but for survival.

If the creature catches you, it won’t end your journey right away — instead, you’ll be dragged to the castle’s prison and locked away. Your teammates must decide: risk everything to free you, or push forward while the danger grows stronger.

The deeper you go, the more dangerous the hunt becomes. The creature adapts, stalks, and strikes without warning. Silence, teamwork, and quick thinking are your only defenses. One mistake, and you may never see the light outside the castle walls again.

Will you uncover the gold and escape the castle’s curse… or will you join the countless others who vanished into the shadows?

Key Features:

  • 4-Player Online Co-op – Face the horror together or perish apart.

  • Puzzle-Driven Exploration – Unlock the castle’s secrets through teamwork and logic.

  • Adaptive Horror AI – A relentless creature that reacts to your actions.

  • Capture & Rescue Mechanic – Get caught, and you’ll be locked in the castle’s prison until freed.

  • Atmospheric Environments – From grand halls to claustrophobic tunnels, every space tells a story.

  • A Tale of Greed and Fear – Uncover the dark truth behind the castle’s curse.
